# Food and Water In CrystallEdge, your characters [color=yellow]have hunger and thirst[/color]. If you don't drink or eat, you will suffer negative effects such as slowing down and taking damage.
## Nutrition
Eating enables your character's [color=yellow]passive health regeneration[/color].
[color=yellow][/color]
# Cooking
Cooked food not only satisfies hunger, but also provides additional bonuses. Usually, they give a special effect called [color=yellow]“Pleasant Aftertaste”[/color], which further increases health regeneration, but the effects may vary from dish to dish. The strength and duration of these effects depend on [color=yellow]the complexity of the recipe[/color] — more complex dishes bring greater bonuses!
The cooking process is very simple. Currently, you can cook [color=yellow]dishes[/color] and [color=yellow]soups[/color] using a frying pan or a cooking pot respectively.
To cook a dish, put the required ingredients inside and place the pan or pot on the heat. Keep an eye on the cooking process, and don't forget to take it off in time, otherwise your dish or soup will turn into burnt mush.
